name: Li Shizhen’s Ben cao gang mu draft
description: Li Shizhen compiled an encyclopedic classification of natural materials in the Ben cao gang mu.

date.basis: Date of the cited witness; not a claim of origin.

events.statement: The Library of Congress dates the first draft of Li Shizhen’s compendium to 1578.

evidence.supports: The Library of Congress attributes the compendium to Li Shizhen and dates its first draft to 1578. It describes an encyclopedic classification of natural materials. Published-edition dates require further investigation.
Reports first draft in 1578 and credits Li Shizhen.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest scoped witness checked here; not the origin of the wider knowledge.

caveats: The date concerns a first draft and does not date the origins of the knowledge compiled. Sources differ on the first printed edition; this record does not assign it a publication date.

research.note: Independent review checked the 1578 first-draft attribution against UNESCO; the Library of Congress item returned access denied in this review. The disputed first printing remains unresolved.
